closeout_verification.note: Closeout was written AFTER bundle freeze (commit bf2d101). The closeout correctly references the frozen bundle SHA. This is the intended behavior of sidecar_proof_protocol_v1.1 — the closeout cannot be inside the bundle it describes.

protocol_gap.gap: sidecar_proof_protocol_v1.1 allowed bundle freeze while taskcards were still PENDING. The 6 pending Lane I taskcards were resolved post-freeze in chore commits. The bundle therefore cannot evidence its own closeout completion.
protocol_gap.impact: LOW — disk state is complete and honest. Bundle is a snapshot of pre-closeout state. External sidecar correctly attests final bundle bytes.
protocol_gap.wave16_protocol_v2_fix: Require all taskcards COMPLETE before bundle freeze. Bundle contains pre-bundle-closeout (not final). External attestation is final authority.

reviewer_finding_response.response: CONFIRMED_ACCURATE_FOR_BUNDLE_STATE. Bundle was frozen at 2dddb28 before LI-04..09 were completed. Disk state has 50/50 COMPLETE (commits bf2d101 + 79e7136). Not fabricated — structurally expected under v1.1 protocol.
